defs.def: easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc. 清晰的；清楚的；明白的；明显的

ex.s: With paper, there is a literal laying on of hands, along with the visual geography of distinct pages.
ex.t: 拿着纸书时，你能实实在在地用手翻阅，还能看到一页页分明的视觉布局。

ex.s: So to try to change a distinctly modern behavior, lawmakers and public health experts are reaching back to an old approach: They want to treat distracted driving like drunk driving.
ex.t: 所以，为了试图改变一种典型的现代行为，立法者和公共卫生专家正在回归一种旧方法：他们想把分心驾驶像酒驾一样对待。

defs.def: clearly different or of a different kind 截然不同的；有区别的；不同种类的

ex.s: We even moved 140,000 square metres of wetland to a new area in order to protect its distinct ecosystem.
ex.t: 我们甚至将14万平方米的湿地迁移到新区域，以保护其独特的生态系统。

ex.s: From their research, they discovered and tested 380 distinct ancient Chinese medical treatments that showed promise in the fight against malaria.
ex.t: 通过研究，他们发现并测试了380种独特的中国古代疗法，这些疗法在抗击疟疾方面显示出了希望。

ex.s: Seven Worlds, One Planet is a documentary that takes the viewer continent has its own distinct geography and climate, which over time has resulted in unique wildlife.
ex.t: 《七个世界，一个星球》是一部纪录片，它向观众展示了每个大陆都有自己独特的地理和气候，久而久之造就了独特的野生动物。

ex.s: It is also one of the most ethnically diverse nations in the world with distinct cultures.
ex.t: 它还是世界上种族最多元的国家之一，拥有独特的文化。

ex.s: Adjectives Synonyms breathtaking broad distinct mighty The website article uses some linking words to add information.
ex.t: 形容词 同义词 令人叹为观止的 广阔的 独特的 强大的 该网站文章使用了一些连接词来补充信息。
